# CleverType

> CleverType is an AI-powered keyboard application that provides real-time grammar correction, tone adjustment, and predictive text for mobile and desktop writing.

CleverType leverages Natural Language Processing and Machine Learning to enhance writing across multiple platforms (iOS and Android). The platform prioritizes user privacy while offering features like next sentence prediction, grammar correction, and style adaptation for diverse user groups including non-native speakers and those with dyslexia.
